body.heading: Too many options, no start
paragraphs: A blank page with no rules can be paralysing. Any topic, any style, any length: the freedom is so wide that choosing feels impossible, and nothing gets made.

A limit shrinks the decision. Write a story in exactly fifty words. Draw with one pen. Cook with three ingredients. Suddenly the question changes from 'what should I do?' to 'how can I do this within the rules?', which is a much friendlier question.

body.heading: Pick a limit, keep it playful
paragraphs: Choose limits that are small and slightly silly rather than harsh: one colour, ten minutes, only questions, no adjectives. Treat them as the rules of a game, not a punishment.
When the piece is done, you may break the limit in revision if you want. Often you will find the limit produced the most original part of the work.

takeaway: When everything is possible, pick a limit and play inside it.
